entries.title: A more finished look on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: Infinitary opens straight onto its own colors instead of a white or black flash, and every title uses its own typeface. Sheets and text fields look like the Mac app's. Joining or leaving a computer asks in an alert that keeps both choices in view.

picture.alt: Infinitary on iPhone shows the Paste its link sheet on its own panel color, its title in the app's typeface above an outlined, rounded link field.
